Frequently Asked Questions

What does Exterprise do?

Exterprise is a ServiceNow Premier Partner for consulting and implementation and a smartsourcing (business process outsourcing) company. We implement and support ServiceNow, including AI Agents and Now Assist, and run business processes such as contact center, records processing and data capture for clients in the US and around the world.

Is Exterprise a ServiceNow partner?

Yes. Exterprise is a ServiceNow Premier Partner for Consulting & Implementation and a licensed ServiceNow reseller, with a team of ServiceNow-accredited professionals and Now Assist certifications for IT Service Management, HR Service Delivery and Creator.

Where is Exterprise located?

Exterprise is headquartered in Dallas, Texas, with offshore delivery centers in Chennai and Coimbatore, India, and a near-shore center in San Pedro Sula, Honduras. More than 500 professionals work across these locations, so work can run around the clock.

Which industries does Exterprise work with?

Exterprise works with county governments, nonprofits and enterprises in government, oil and gas, retail and real estate, delivering ServiceNow, outsourcing and custom technology solutions.

What solutions does Exterprise offer?

Exterprise offers three solutions: ServOps, for service operations excellence on ServiceNow (servops.com); UtterNow, which lets people run ServiceNow workflows by voice (utternow.ai); and Omnitix, omni-channel contact center solutions with multilingual, 24/7 support across voice, email, text and chat (omnitix.us).

How do I start a project with Exterprise?

Email contact@exterprise.us or send a message from the Contact page. A consultant or ServiceNow architect will review your goals and suggest the right next step, whether that is an assessment, an implementation plan or a dedicated team.
